dedupe_keys.name: dataset for field validation of kpi informed energy efficiency improvements in two small data centers

description: Simon Melgaard and colleagues publish temperature and energy measurements from small data-centre pilots at Aalborg University and the Poznan Supercomputing and Networking Center. The September 2026 deposit supplies CSV files in two TAR.XZ archives under CC BY 4.0. Aalborg tests combine four airflow configurations with four IT-load levels, producing sixteen files. Measurements include inlet, outlet, cooling supply and return temperatures, IT and facility power, and calculated cooling and energy indicators. Poznan supplies temperature and thermal indicators only because power measurements were unavailable. The observations can calibrate cooling simulations or compare retrofit scenarios. Measurement dates, sampling intervals and sensor uncertainty remain unknown from the public summary. The two sites should not be assumed to have matching variables. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this campaign. The CSV files were not downloaded.
